entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pavel Pavlovich Demidov, 2nd Prince of San Donato was a Russian industrialist, jurist, master of the hunt at Russian imperial court, philanthropist and nobleman of the House of Demidov. He was the only child of Finnish philanthropist Aurora Karamzin and Prince Pavel Nikolaievich Demidov.
